### Complete Solver Architecture

The final solver in [solution.cpp](file:///workspace/benchmarks/ahc004/solution.cpp) executes a multi-start workflow combining six core phases:

1. Maximal Read Filtering: Identifies duplicate strings and removes strict subsegments that are contained inside longer reads to minimize overlap graph dimensions.
2. Exact O(1) Prefix Trie Evaluator: Maintains match state across all 800 toroidal starting positions, evaluating cell changes incrementally in constant time.
3. Multi-Restart Bidirectional Greedy Superstring Assembly: Computes overlap graphs across randomized read orderings, packing long reads into 20 toroidal lines.
4. 4-Way Torus Invariant Simulated Annealing: Searches cyclic row shifts, row permutations, col shifts, and col permutations. Row shifts leave horizontal substrings intact while creating vertical intersection matches.
5. Progressive 2D Low-Conflict Placement: Scans unplaced reads and injects them into grid positions with minimal character conflicts whenever aggregate score increases.
6. Dot Filling and Coordinate Descent: Fills remaining blank cells with optimal letters and quenches all 400 cells to local optimality.
7. Multi-Candidate Large Neighborhood Search: Samples unplaced reads, finds top partial matching alignments, injects full strings, repairs the modified cells with coordinate descent, and keeps improvements or reverts via an exact undo stack.
8. Dual-Seed Multi-Start: Runs the complete multi-stage pipeline across two independent random seeds within the 1.3-second per-instance budget, returning the highest-scoring grid.

The best known source code remains in [benchmarks/ahc004/solution.cpp](file:///workspace/benchmarks/ahc004/solution.cpp).
